violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: A change of ownership occurred on December 18. A food permit with the watermark 2026 was issued to the facility. Upon inspection of the permit, the expiration date was observed to be for December 31, 2025.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure. EHS SPOKE WITH MANAGEMENT ABOUT RENEWING FOR THE 2026 FOOD PERMIT. MANAGEMENT WILL RENEW WITHIN 48 HOURS. PLEASE NOTIFY EHS WHEN RENEWAL OCCURS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
